## Why visit

A characterful counterpoint to the polished brewery pubs: conversation, accumulated memorabilia and a cosy winter atmosphere are central to its appeal. The community ownership and long history as an independent ale outlet make it a rewarding place to linger rather than merely tick off. Its position on the Edgeley side of Stockport station makes it a useful final stop when the opening pattern fits. Choose it for changing cask and an individual pub personality; its modest size and evening focus are part of the experience and need to shape the day’s order.

## Beer

CAMRA documents six changing guest ales and tasting thirds; styles and breweries rotate. Recent CAMRA cask sightings include Fyne Ales Jarl, Oakham Citra and Brew York Tonkoko, but no permanent named beer is established.

## Plan the visit

Usually an evening venue with Monday/Tuesday closure; Saturday opening can vary with Stockport County home matches. Verify directly.
